topic: Restoring PostgreSQL to a recovery target
title: Restoring PostgreSQL to a recovery target
brief: Restore a PostgreSQL cluster to a verified target and account for the work outside that history.
outcomes: Build and test a base-backup and archived-WAL chain
Verify a target and reconcile later valid effects safely
entry: General backup reasoning and PostgreSQL WAL.

heading.title: A restorable chain
heading.brief: Pin a disposable setup, base backup, archive destination and credentials; verify continuous required WAL and distinguish pg_dump from physical recovery.

heading.title: The recovery target
heading.brief: Locate the proposed mistake using recorded transaction evidence; explain target inclusion, time zones and the chosen recovery action.

heading.title: Restore and acceptance
heading.brief: Recover in isolation, inspect timeline and target state, deliberately test a missing segment and verify application totals and references.

heading.title: Returning to service
heading.brief: Fence the earlier writer, reconcile valid later orders and card effects by stable identity, then define write-authority transfer and cleanup.
